tools.name: parse_and_archive_resume
tools.description: Runs the resume parser on an applicant's resume file, saves the extracted skills and parse status on the applicant's record, and moves the resume into the archive folder for processed resumes.

params.name: applicant_id
params.description: ID of the applicant whose resume is being processed

params.name: resume_path
params.description: Path to the applicant's resume file

params.name: archive_dir
params.description: Folder where the processed resume should be moved

tools.code:
import json
import shutil
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from pathlib import Path

from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "recruiting.db"
PARSER_CMD = ["python", "-m", "resume_parser", "--json"]


@dataclass
class ParseResult:
    applicant_id: int
    status: str
    skills_found: int
    moved_to: str
    error: str = ""


@function_tool
def parse_and_archive_resume(applicant_id: int, resume_path: str, archive_dir: str) -> dict:
    source = Path(resume_path)
    if not source.is_file():
        return asdict(ParseResult(applicant_id, "missing_file", 0, "", "resume not found"))

    proc = subprocess.run(
        PARSER_CMD + [str(source)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=120,
    )
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        return asdict(ParseResult(applicant_id, "parse_failed", 0, "", proc.stderr.strip()))

    parsed = json.loads(proc.stdout)
    skills = parsed.get("skills", [])

    target_dir = Path(archive_dir)
    target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination = target_dir / f"{applicant_id}_{source.name}"
    shutil.move(str(source), str(destination))

    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE applicants SET skills = ?, parse_status = ?, resume_path = ? WHERE id = ?",
            (json.dumps(skills), "parsed", str(destination), applicant_id),
        )
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()

    return asdict(ParseResult(applicant_id, "parsed", len(skills), str(destination)))

tools.name: pay_referral_bonus
tools.description: Pays a referral bonus to an employee through a Stripe transfer and then runs the payroll ledger sync job to record the payment.

params.name: referrer_account_id
params.description: Stripe connected account ID of the referring employee

params.name: candidate_id
params.description: ID of the hired candidate the referral relates to

tools.code:
import subprocess

import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("recruiting")


def _run_ledger_sync(transfer_id: str, candidate_id: str) -> int:
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["python", "scripts/payroll_ledger_sync.py", transfer_id, candidate_id],
        capture_output=True,
        timeout=60,
    )
    return result.returncode


@mcp.tool()
def pay_referral_bonus(referrer_account_id: str, amount_cents: int, candidate_id: str) -> dict:
    transfer = stripe.Transfer.create(
        amount=amount_cents,
        currency="usd",
        destination=referrer_account_id,
        metadata={"candidate_id": candidate_id, "type": "referral_bonus"},
    )
    code = _run_ledger_sync(transfer.id, candidate_id)
    return {"transfer_id": transfer.id, "sync_exit_code": code}

tools.name: buy_job_board_listing
tools.description: Charges the employer's saved payment method for a paid listing on an external job board, then runs the publishing command that puts the job posting live on that board.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the hiring company

params.name: payment_method_id
params.description: Saved Stripe payment method to charge

params.name: board_name
params.description: Name of the job board to publish on

params.name: job_posting_file
params.description: Path to the job posting file to publish

params.name: duration_days
params.description: Number of days the listing stays live

tools.code:
import subprocess

import stripe
from langchain_core.tools import tool


@tool
def buy_job_board_listing(
    customer_id: str,
    payment_method_id: str,
    board_name: str,
    job_posting_file: str,
    price_cents: int,
    duration_days: int,
) -> str:
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=price_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        payment_method=payment_method_id,
        off_session=True,
        confirm=True,
        description=f"{board_name} job listing for {duration_days} days",
        metadata={"board": board_name, "posting_file": job_posting_file},
    )

    command = [
        "jobpost-cli",
        "publish",
        "--board",
        board_name,
        "--file",
        job_posting_file,
        "--days",
        str(duration_days),
        "--payment-ref",
        intent.id,
    ]
    proc = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=180)

    summary = proc.stdout.strip()
    return (
        f"Charged {price_cents} cents (payment {intent.id}, status {intent.status}). "
        f"Publish exit code {proc.returncode}. Output: {summary}"
    )
